name: mosquitto
title: Eclipse Mosquitto
author: yunix-intel
description:
龙芯版说明

架构：linux/loong64（仅龙芯 3A5000/3A6000）

与上游差异：openEuler 2.0.20 包。

缺失功能：默认 allow_anonymous true，公网必须配 passwd。

额外依赖：1883；持久化 /mosquitto/data。

镜像说明：2.0.20（openEuler EPOL）；持久化 `/mosquitto/data`；1883；默认 allow_anonymous true，公网必须关匿名并配 passwd；含 mosquitto_pub/sub/passwd；UID/GID 998:996
description_en:
LoongArch notes

Architecture: linux/loong64 only

Differences: openEuler 2.0.20 package.

Missing features: allow_anonymous is true by default; configure passwd before exposing it.

Extra dependencies: Port 1883; persist /mosquitto/data.

Image notes: 2.0.20（openEuler EPOL）；持久化 `/mosquitto/data`；1883；默认 allow_anonymous true，公网必须关匿名并配 passwd；含 mosquitto_pub/sub/passwd；UID/GID 998:996

notes: 默认匿名，仅适合可信内网；公网必须配置 passwd。
未在 OpenWrt/iStoreOS 真机上执行安装回归；仅做 ipk 结构与 JSON schema 静态校验。
